decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line builds directly on the firm's established track and luminaire knowledge, so after two years on the market the firm can interpret its results and refine models rather than withdraw it.
The LED ceiling luminaire sits in the firm's core competence and uses its existing design, planning data and dealer channels, which gives the firm strong capacity to improve it from market feedback.
The flexible LED spotlight launched in 2024 is close to the existing spotlight offer and has its own page, so the firm can readily learn from early results and keep developing the line.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a system accessory that extends the modular pendant offer, so it relies on existing technical knowledge and supports sales of related luminaires.
The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy builds on the firm's low-voltage and modular system expertise, letting it assimilate installer feedback and keep the component within its flexible system offer.

The round glass track luminaires fit the firm's track system and design knowledge, but they are only mentioned rather than presented on their own page, which signals somewhat weaker visibility and slightly higher risk while keeping is still the likely choice.
